description: Where the sun is in the sky right now — or at any timestamp — for any coordinates: azimuth (compass bearing), elevation angle, cardinal direction, right ascension and declination, from the NOAA solar equations. Deterministic astronomy for shadow math, solar-panel orientation and photo planning. Use this when an agent needs to azimuth, altitude and cardinal direction, now or any time. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
